text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, in the Trainer's office.
...I mentally rehearsed the apology I had
spent all night pondering over.
choice_data_list: (I feel awful for her... but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
my colleague's concerns were completely valid.
Signing a contract
like this wouldn't be in K.S.Miracle's best
interest above all else.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me...
...! ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I gritted my teeth through the guilt
and frustration, preparing to bow my head—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so sorry.
Please feel free to completely forget about
the contract.
I just came by today to let you know that.
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I should have realized sooner when I heard
you were a rookie...
It hit me later that you probably didn't
know about my body.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's always been the reason everyone turned
me down in the past...
So when you approached me,
I just got completely carried away.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Without explaining the situation,
it was practically like tricking you into
a contract.
I'm sure that must have troubled you,
right?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You looked so troubled when I walked in,
too...
I'm sorry.
Let's pretend none of it ever happened.
choice_data_list: No... You don't have to apologize...
No... You don't have to apologize...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but hearing you say that I was fast
made me so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll take what happened yesterday as
encouragement... and work even harder
so I can properly earn a contract. ...Much,
much harder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath her quiet demeanor dwelled a fierce
determination.
...The words from yesterday echoed back.
"Work even harder"—
she really would push herself like that,
wouldn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even for a contract on which her entire life
depended,
she turned it down out of consideration
for my circumstances.
Her thoughtfulness toward others was far
deeper than I could have imagined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying such deep consideration and kindness
in her heart...
Just how far would she push herself "to
repay her debt of gratitude"?
choice_data_list: (It's not that she can't stop—she ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to speak up,
though whether it was out of irresponsible
worry
or merely an attempt at atonement...
I couldn't tell.
choice_data_list: You're planning to participate in ...
You're planning to participate in ...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ? Yes. I've already signed up for it.
choice_data_list: Could I help you practice until th...
Could I help you practice until th...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But... are you sure that's okay?
Don't you have a lot on your plate,
Trainer...?
choice_data_list: It's fine. ...I look forward to wo...
It's fine. ...I look forward to wo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later.
When I arrived at the track ahead of our
scheduled training time—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Ah, Trainer!
. Thank you for coming. .
choice_data_list: Did you already finish warming up?
Did you already finish warming up?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Just a quick routine—
warm-up and stretches, and...
Ah, I also set out the equipment we might
need just in case.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Did I get a bit too carried away? Ahaha...
It's just such an important opportunity,
so I want to do everything I can.
choice_data_list: An opportunity for scouting, you mean?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes, that too,
but... the Track Meet is
an event where guests from outside the
academy can come watch.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My doctor and my parents are coming to see
me.
All the precious people in my life...
who did so much for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to give it my all.
As much as I possibly can.
...I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah—!
choice_data_list: Looking good! Focus on your arm swing!
Looking good! Focus on your arm swing!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!! ...Focus on...
the arm swing...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa...! Phew...
choice_data_list: Good work. Want to take a longer b...
Good work. Want to take a longer b...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No! Rehydrating is plenty for me.
Once we head back to campus,
let's move on to the next routine...!
choice_data_list: (...She's such a good girl...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Utterly earnest,
giving everything she had...
Our days of training together continued on
in this manner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, with the competition drawing near,
we decided to have dinner together
off-campus to take a breather, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Thank you for the meal!
That carrot râpées sandwich was delicious.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Um,
are you really sure it's okay to treat me?
Even though you're already overseeing my
training and all...
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it at all. More ...
Don't worry about it at all. More ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I asked if she was really finished eating.
Two carrot râpées sandwiches
seemed far too little for an Umamusume's
appetite...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm already full...
I've always been a light eater, or rather—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...When I was little,
I could barely eat anything at all.
That's actually why I was constantly
hospitalized.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My legs didn't even have the strength to
run or walk...
Most of the time,
I couldn't even leave my bed.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yet now,
I'm able to run at full speed like this.
...It's incredible, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Nothing is decided as impossible.
Do you want to run around full of energy?
Then that is what you shall do.
Making that possible is our job.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely,
K.S.Miracle.
You don't have to give up on anything.
...It will be all right.
We are right here with you.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Kei-chan! Were you reading a picture book? Oh,
what a lovely swan.
...I'm so glad,
you seem to be feeling well today.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Look what I brought today—
homemade banana mousse!
I made it extra soft so it's easy for you
to eat.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Just eat as much as you can,
and let's do our best with your walking
training.
Mom and Dad will do our best right beside you.
...We're always here with you.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Very good, just like that!
Let's try picking up the speed,
only as much as is comfortable!!

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... You're amazing, Kei-chan,
amazing!! Look how fast you are!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everything I have was given to me by everyone
else.
My life, my body, my legs,
my dreams... and this miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So now, it's my turn. I want to give back.
Through my running. By winning a GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still,
they're always worrying about my health and
my body... So at the Exhibition Meet,
I wanted to show them that I'm completely
fine now.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why you've been such a tremendous
help to me!
Even if it's only temporary,
having you guide me like this... truly.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah,
I'm sorry for rambling on like that! Um...
Would you like to order something,
Trainer? Dessert, perhaps?
choice_data_list: No... I'm already completely full.
No... I'm already completely full.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave a gentle shake of my head in response.
I truly was full.
My heart was simply overflowing with the
profound kindness radiating from her.
